name: Rest and Relaxation

angles.text: The Lion's Pride Inn is a haven and gathering place for Alliance travelers in Elwynn Forest.
As a human recruit leaving Northshire Valley, you follow the southern road to Goldshire. There, Innkeeper Farley offers familiar hospitality near Stormwind.

aliases: how to get to lion's pride inn
faq.answer: The Lion's Pride Inn is in Goldshire, south along the main road from Northshire Valley. Follow the road south to the tavern at the heart of town.
faq.q: Where can I find the Lion's Pride Inn?

faq.answer: Innkeeper Farley runs the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. A close friend of contacts in Northshire, he welcomes weary adventurers with food, drink, and a warm hearth.

aliases: what is the purpose of this quest
why go to lion's pride inn
faq.answer: You travel from Northshire to Goldshire, where Innkeeper Farley offers food, drink, and lodging at the Lion's Pride Inn.
faq.q: What is the purpose of Rest and Relaxation?

aliases: do i get cheaper food farley
faq.answer: Mention your referral to Innkeeper Farley, and you can ask about discounted food and drink while you recover from your travels.
faq.q: Does Innkeeper Farley really offer discounted food and drink?

faq.answer: Travel across Elwynn is hard and dangerous. At an inn, you can shelter from the wilderness, warm yourself by the fire, recover, and replenish supplies before setting out again.
faq.q: Why is rest important for traveling adventurers?

aliases: what is lions pride inn motto
faq.answer: Innkeeper Farley says the Lion's Pride Inn's motto is 'Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold.' Weary guests can find comfort by his hearth.
faq.q: What is the motto of the Lion's Pride Inn?

sections.body: Weary travelers leave Northshire and follow the road south to Goldshire. It leads straight to the Lion's Pride Inn, where Innkeeper Farley welcomes those setting out into Elwynn Forest. For new adventurers, the inn is the first major outpost beyond the Abbey, with shelter and hot meals.
sections.title: A Haven on the Road

sections.body: Innkeeper Farley welcomes those who are tired and cold. Mention your referral, and you can settle by the open fire for a warm meal, sturdy ale, and a rest before continuing through Elwynn.
sections.title: Farley's Hearth and Hospitality

summary: From Northshire, new Alliance adventurers follow the road south to Goldshire for rest and welcome. At the Lion's Pride Inn, Innkeeper Farley offers food, drink, and a place by the hearth.
attribution: In-game quest text: Rest and Relaxation
